findings.excerpt:
have he : (∑ k, K.curvature k k z) =
      (∑ k, mderiv Complex.I (e k) (mderiv (-Complex.I) (e k) K.matrix) z) -
      ∑ k, mderiv Complex.I (e k) K.matrix z*mderiv (-Complex.I) (e k) K.matrix z := by
    simp only [K.curvature_formula hz, hM,inv_one,one_mul,mul_one,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [he,hc,add_sub_cancel_right]
  rfl
findings.problem: The auxiliary equality he manually repeats a large expansion solely to rewrite the goal immediately afterward. Its proof can instead simplify the goal directly.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace the proof body with:
by
  have hc := ricci_cancellation_at_one K.isOpen K.smooth K.positive K.closed hz hM
  simp only [K.curvature_formula hz, hM, inv_one, one_mul, mul_one,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hc, add_sub_cancel_right]
  rfl
findings.benefit: Removes the duplicated derivative expression while retaining the same explicit mathematical steps: expand curvature at the identity, apply Ricci cancellation, and cancel the quadratic term.
